facts.text: Většinu roku spí zahrabaný v zemi, aktivní je jen v období dešťů.
facts.quote: aestivates most of the year, during which they are buried underground, and are only active during the rainy season

facts.text: Živí se hlavně hmyzem a plži, občas i palmovými semeny.
facts.quote: composed mainly insect parts and snail shells, although palm seeds were also occasionally present

facts.text: Snáší jen jedno nebo dvě vejce, ale vícekrát za rok.
facts.quote: Clutch size is small, only one or two eggs, although each female lays more than one clutch per year.

facts.text: Pohlaví mláďat se určuje podle teploty.
facts.quote: Sex of the hatchlings is determined by temperature.
